ranking.name: St. James Hotel New Orleans Downtown

text.text_excerpt: I highly recommend this hotel! The location was perfect; right in the French Quarters. We were walking distance to the French Market, Pharmacy Museum, and so close to Bourbon St. that we stumbled back to our room with no problems. When we wanted to travel outside of the French Quarters, we were only a block away from Canal St. where we could hop on a street car. The staff was very friendly throughout our stay. The moment we arrived, the young lady checking us in gave us a 25 minute introduction to the city. She pulled out a map, asked us what interested us most about New Orleans and gave us helpful ideas about how we could maximize our 5 day vacation. ***Thank you again, Ingrid!*** I'm no...

Stayed here one night and was very happy to do so. Came in town very excited and was helped thru things by the friendly and knowledgeable woman who worked evenings (Alicia I think?)....Anyway, great location just off from the Quarter. Very nice restaurant across the street and another hotel just down the street with an open bar on the sidewalk. It all felt very New Orleans. My room was impressive. Large with a comfortable bed, nice TV, Refrig, open floor to ceiling paneled doors that led to a closed off small balcony. The bathroom was spacious and the toiletries were stylishly provided. This was my first time staying at the St. James Hotel. I had a King room for a week. Unfortunately, it was one of the older rooms that hadn't been renovated yet. There was bad caulking all over the bathroom, the safe didn't work & the TV didn't work well. I probably should have requested a different room right from the start, but didn't think about it at the time. On the plus side, the bed was really comfortable & I particularly liked the pillows. The public areas of the hotel have been well maintained; very pretty & relaxing. The location is a convenient 10 minute walk (or less, depending on how quickly you walk) to the French Quarter.
